Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: TECHNICAL LAYER ATLAS for production of an existing pixel-art Godot game, EMPIRE. The input is the exact scene to reconstruct as separate layers. Keep its recognizable oak, woodland, pale rock valley, shelter, materials and beautiful deliberate pixel art. This is NOT a new scene composition.
Generate ONE RGBA atlas, 1280 pixels wide x1440 high, divided into EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal640x360 cells, with NO gutters, frames, text, numbers, captions or labels. Each cell is the SAME full16:9 camera frame at half the intended1280x720 gameplay scale. Objects keep the same screen-relative positions in their cell. Each layer is isolated on REAL TRANSPARENCY except the sky cell. No painted checkerboard or colored background. No people, king, workers, animals or shadows from people anywhere.
Cell positions, row-major, left then right:
TOP LEFT: sky and organized pixel clouds ONLY, entirely opaque edge to edge, no hills, trees, castle, terrain, actors, architecture or water.
TOP RIGHT: distant pale mountains and cliff silhouettes ONLY, isolated with transparent sky above; extend the distant landscape behind all occluded foreground objects. Remove all distant houses, towers and castles so cities are not baked into the natural world.
ROW2 LEFT: middle-distance wooded hills and valley ONLY, isolated with transparent area above silhouette; fully reconstruct the landscape behind the oak and shelter; no buildings or terrain from the walking path.
ROW2 RIGHT: the large oak and near woodland vegetation/boulders ONLY, with complete silhouettes and transparent everything else, no sky, hills, buildings, people or soil bank. Reconstruct any branches/roots hidden by characters. The oak roots end near y258 in this cell.
ROW3 LEFT: the natural soil bank and surface terrain ONLY, full-width near the bottom. At this cell's640x360 size, the UPPER WALKING LINE is y258.5 (71.8% down) and the lower WALKING LINE is y309.25 (85.9% down). Only50.75pixels between them. Paint beautiful mossy soil and stone between levels, with a shallow lower terrace; no people, buildings, ladders, grass walls or other background layers. Transparent above the upper ground edge. Do NOT enlarge the gap or put upper floor near60%. Both floors are horizontal.
ROW3 RIGHT: WATER ONLY, isolated. Since this woodland scene is dry, this cell is ENTIRELY transparent and EMPTY. Do not invent a lake.
BOTTOM LEFT: the wooden forester shelter, lower storage alcove facade, drystone boundary wall and substantial structural props ONLY, isolated in the SAME relative scene positions with real transparency around/between them. No terrain, sky, trees, people or water. Architecture floor aligns to y258.5 upper and y309.25 lower.
BOTTOM RIGHT: separate small foreground props: short wooden access ladder connecting y258.5 to309.25 near x390, a few crates and barrels placed at margins, sparse grasses/ferns at bottom edges. Full transparent background, no architecture or landscape. Keep the lower ladder landing and both walking lanes visually clear.
All panels are REGISTERED to their640x360 coordinate frame. Pixel art is at this cell'snative pixels: square clusters and intentional stepped edges, limited colors, no tiny noise, no antialiasing, blur, bloom, photographic gradients or painterly smearing. Retain the approved rich silhouettes and selected textures. DO NOT show an assembled final scene in any cell and do not place all layers together. This atlas will be split into eight images and recombined by the game.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE technical production LAYER ATLAS for the supplied EMPIRE pixel-art scene. Keep its recognizable landscape, architecture identities, beautiful selective detail and crisp deliberate pixel clusters; do not invent another location.
Exactly2 columns x4 rows, eight full16:9 layer panels, row-major left to right. Suggested whole canvas1280x1440, each panel640x360. No frames, gaps, words, labels, numbers, grid lines or captions.
Each cell is a separately ISOLATED layer, using the SAME camera and spatial arrangement, not another assembled scene. REAL fully transparent unused background except opaque sky. NO people, kings, workers, animals, character shadows or reference actors anywhere. Repair the small areas where they stood.
1 TOP LEFT: only the opaque sky and pixel clouds. No landscape or structures.
2 TOP RIGHT: only far mountains/cliffs and distant natural silhouettes, transparent sky above. Extend all occluded landscape. REMOVE ALL houses, cities, towers and castles.
3 ROW2 LEFT: only middle-distance hills, forests, islands and valley landscape, with transparent sky above. Complete behind the near tree and buildings. No active settlements.
4 ROW2 RIGHT: only near natural vegetation and rock groupings, isolated completely. Full uncut silhouettes with some transparent padding around them; don't crop tree crowns or roots. NO soil bank or buildings. Keep these natural objects separate from architecture.
5 ROW3 LEFT: only the natural soil bank, upper path and shallow lower dry TERRAIN, isolated from sky, water and buildings. Keep upper walking line around72% and lower around86% of each panel height, a shallow102px gap at720px gameplay. Do not bake a tree, actor, ladder or structure into terrain. Across water, lower left/right banks stay separate with transparent gaps, never invented continuous floors.
6 ROW3 RIGHT: WATER ONLY, completely isolated water shapes, matching the source's channels and foreground water; no boats, bank, bridge, pilings, land or other background. If source is dry, leave this panel FULLY transparent rather than invent water.
7 BOTTOM LEFT: architecture and large structural objects ONLY, isolated: houses, shelters, bridges, docks, cranes, large boats present in the source. Same recognizable structures with no terrain or sky. No people.
8 BOTTOM RIGHT: small functional and decorative props ONLY, separated from each other on real transparency: the short access ladder, a few crates/barrels/nets and small local foreground plants. No terrain, big buildings or background.
Hard crisp pixel alpha and stair-step contours, source's beautiful rich materials and silhouettes, limited purposeful color ramps, no noise, smoothing, antialiasing, colored fringes, matte, vignette or photographic gradients. Preserve the scale hierarchy, leave routes uncluttered. This is an eight-layer ASSET SHEET for later export, NOT a poster, scene collage, overview or labeled infographic.
SOURCE LOCATION: Bruma. Preserve this scene's specific local plants, geology and buildings.
Isolate the existing water into panel6; keep dry lower banks/landings separated by its real channel.
Keep all large near silhouettes complete with transparent margins; there must be no hard rectangular cut across a tree or mountain. Upper/lower useful walking height remains shallow.
